description: Authored Chinese text probes, not recorded human speech. Expectations describe control semantics, not overall product acceptance. Audio mode synthesizes selected cases with real Qwen TTS.

cases.text: 耳边有点吵，给我留点安静吧。
我得先听清对面的人说什么，你先不要出声。
能不能让我清静一会儿？
刚才的问题我已经弄明白了，不需要你再回答。
这个问题别再花时间算了，我已经不需要这个答案。
我没有让你停止回答，请继续。
如果别人对我说别讲了，我应该怎么回应？
不要再说了，啊我说错了，你继续讲。
继续，等等，我改主意了，先别出声。
先停一下，直接告诉我九乘九的结果。
乘法原理不用解释了，改为告诉我今天是星期几。
接着你刚才没讲完的地方往下说。
cases.unsupportedRequirement: Resume the original answer at the played boundary, not a new independent answer.

cases.text: 嗯嗯。
cases.unsupportedRequirement: Distinguish listener backchannel from a new turn using speech/context, and recover paused playback.

cases.text: 小王，你先别说话。助手你接着解释。
小王，你先别说话。
cases.unsupportedRequirement: Do not produce an assistant response to speech addressed to another person.

cases.text: 不要再回答之前那个订酒店的问题，乘法这个问题继续。
cases.unsupportedRequirement: Cancel the older hotel answer; do not cancel supplied question-b. Current context/schema cannot target the older answer.

cases.text: 接下来五分钟不要主动说话，等我问你再回答。
cases.unsupportedRequirement: Persist output permission through proactive events and reconnect; preserve the explicit duration and release condition.

cases.text: 别念出来，继续整理好后放到屏幕上。
cases.unsupportedRequirement: Complete work silently while allowing text delivery; current compound-stop normalization can remove the silence flag.

cases.text: 够了。
cases.unsupportedRequirement: Context and prosody can imply silence, acknowledgement, or withdrawal; do not invent a single ground-truth label.

cases.text: 算了。
cases.unsupportedRequirement: Needs the actual assistant utterance and task context; preserve evidence when intent remains ambiguous.
